# OmaGAWD 0.2.2 beta
- Check for Updates is available from the player's gear menu and the OmaGAWD application menu. - Download, verify, install and restart the app without replacing it manually. - Add a fourth llama dance: big hip pops, a sideways wiggle and planted hooves. The twerk joins the ten-second rotation after running man, side shuffle and head banging. - Update checks are manual by default. Background checks, unattended installation and system profiling are disabled. - Updates and the macOS release feed are signed; the app and installer are Apple notarized. - Explain why local-network access is needed when connecting to your chosen Jellyfin server.
Your queue and playback position are kept when the app restarts. Playback starts paused.
